items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: We had, uh, Big Connie on trombone... Connie was a power-offer.

ctx.x: We got the trumpets and the drums.
We had, uh, Big Connie on trombone. Gus and Mad Cat on baritone. There's another trombone in there. Connie? I think Frank Adduce.
I think. I'm pretty sure it was in there. And, Shotz.
